# Good Dog

![Good Dog](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/good_dog.png)

Heads: 2 points; return the highest-scoring coin played this level to the draw pile. Once per level.

- **Rarity:** Epic
- **Heads chance:** 43%
- **Shop price:** 28 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 2 points, fetch_best

## Tails
Nothing

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade), [The Seer](characters-seer), [The Trader](characters-trader)
